decisions.summary: Flat research/questions/ layout, stem NNNN-<slug>, four-digit numbers allocated once in initial table-of-contents order, later by make reserve KIND=question
decisions.why: FR-001/FR-002 and message 2's flat storage; allocation order is an allocation choice and the number never changes on regrouping

decisions.summary: tags marker after the heading; second drawing pages are own stems with about:; the 231 paired about: declarations removed; Presentation become drawing-only stems in map-conventions
decisions.why: FR-006, FR-007, FR-012 and the measured Edge Case; the paired about: marker is a pointer the stem pairing replaces

decisions.summary: A page's note references resolve only in its own notes; the 19 cross-question notes copied into the citing notes file; all.html numbers notes once by (page, key)
decisions.why: Mechanical consequence of one page per question (FR-001); content unchanged (FR-003, FR-015)

decisions.summary: In-record links rewritten relative to questions/ by resolving each with the old index; build refuses a link that lands nowhere
decisions.why: FR-017 cross-links and FR-020; the refusal only enforces that the rewritten references land (message 3)

decisions.summary: tags.json and contents.json shapes; takes clauses over primary/subject/setting/level; home = first match depth-first; initial leaves take their primary subject; Map conventions last before Sources
decisions.why: FR-005, FR-009, FR-010, FR-013; clauses select on any facet as the GM asked

decisions.summary: Site: index, per-section pages per half, flat site/q/<heading id>.html, per-tag pages, all.html; maps link q/

_front.html reader text moves into section descriptions, session comments dropped; _tail.html and per-part citations pages retired, tools read per-question notes; research.md R9 lists each opening and where its text went or that it was retired and why
decisions.why: FR-016 now carried in the artifact it names (research.md), closing round 1's mismatch; the retired part-level files have no reader in the new layout and the three tools keep working (FR-019)

decisions.summary: Repository-wide sweep of every old form (fragment path, assembled page, whole page -> contents.json#section, prose pointer, page NNN and page/NNN numbers, each number rewrite listed for review); the pointer check validates new forms and refuses old forms present in moved-303.json, naming the new pointer; exempt request.md, SOURCE blocks, moved-303.json
decisions.why: FR-017/FR-018; request.md and SOURCE blocks are the spec's own exemptions, and moved-303.json is the spec's Migration mapping entity, which must hold old paths. Listing number rewrites for review serves getting the correct new number (message 3)

decisions.summary: Exemption within the feature directory confined to migration.md, which holds only the generated old-to-new mapping; everything else in specs/303 is swept and checked like any landed spec
decisions.why: Round 1's condition met exactly: only the old->new statements physically need old names (the spec's Migration mapping entity cannot state a mapping without its left side). The spec, research, plan and tasks of 303 now carry new stems like every landed spec (FR-017, SC-007, message 3). migration.md's contents (the mapping and the list of number rewrites, old->new) are both the mapping, so one argument covers one class

decisions.summary: A range in a landed brief is rewritten to the new numbers of the questions it covered; a range covering no question is left as written and passes the check without an escape because neither end is a (page, number) in the mapping
decisions.why: Round 1's conditions met: only a range covering no question is left, and such a range names no research question, so FR-017 (every reference to a research question) and message 3 (references by number use the correct new number) have nothing to rewrite it to. The plan says how it passes the check with no escape, and the reason is true by construction (a range covering no question has no question at either end)

decisions.summary: PAGE=/SECTION= become Q=NNNN, PAGE= becomes IN=<section or tag>; one select() in _hm_record.py; hooks and briefs emit the new forms; fragment-move renames a stem
decisions.why: FR-019: a stem, a tag or a section where a page was taken

decisions.summary: Delete record/split.py, store.write_fragments, write_notes_fragments, make record SPLIT= and COLLECTIONS rather than port them
decisions.why: SPLIT= splits a page that is still whole and no whole page exists in either layout (R1: every question is already a fragment); porting it is impossible in substance and the organization request loses nothing

decisions.summary: tags.md generated per stem with number, title, tags, level, home section and convention ruling
Peer clones checked for unpushed research/ commits and reported; late old paths refused at push with the new path named
decisions.why: FR-018 and the in-flight peer Edge Case
